image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and some printed black text. Two circular windows reveal the internal spools; the left spool appears to have tape wound around it, while the right spool looks mostly empty or has a white hub. A rectangular opening at the bottom exposes the magnetic tape mechanism. There are visible signs of wear, dirt, and yellowing on the plastic.
